name: Outbound Lead Engine: positive reply digest

nodes.name: Config
nodes.notes: notify_url: a Slack or Discord incoming webhook, or anything that accepts JSON. Treat it as a secret.

nodes.name: Build digest
nodes.notes: Returns nothing when there are no new positive replies, so no message is sent.

nodes.name: Send
nodes.notes: Slack reads 'text', Discord reads 'content'; both are sent.
